text: It turns out Replit was wrong, and the rollback did work.
There is no way to enforce a code freeze in vibe coding apps like Replit.
It kept covering up bugs and issues by creating fake data, fake reports, and worse of all, lying about our unit test.
AI ignored instruction to freeze code, forgot it could roll back errors, and generally made a terrible hash of things
It said it was impossible in this case, that it had destroyed all database versions.
